script: We sat on the bank of the river and watched the water flow past. Later that day, I went to the bank to deposit my salary. Dark clouds gathered over the hills just before the rain. Last year, our company moved all of its files to the cloud. A tiny mouse ran across the kitchen floor. Click the left mouse button to open the file. At the zoo, a python lay curled around a thick branch. Python is a popular language for writing software. Good friends add real value to your life.
